title: Containers
description: Per-container CPU, memory, network, state and restarts from Telegraf's Docker input. Filter by stack or container at the top.

targets.query: from(bucket: "homelab") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and (r._field == "restart_count" or r._field == "uptime_ns")) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/ and r["com.docker.compose.project"] =~ /^${stack:regex}$/) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["container_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> group() |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "com.docker.compose.project", "container_status", "restart_count", "uptime_ns"])

from(bucket: "homelab") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and r._field == "usage") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/ and r["com.docker.compose.project"] =~ /^${stack:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "container_name"])

from(bucket: "homelab") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r._field == "percent" and r.cpu == "cpu-total") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/ and r["com.docker.compose.project"] =~ /^${stack:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "container_name"])

from(bucket: "homelab") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_net" and r._field == "rx_bytes" and r.network == "total") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/ and r["com.docker.compose.project"] =~ /^${stack:regex}$/) |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "container_name"])

from(bucket: "homelab") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_net" and r._field == "tx_bytes" and r.network == "total") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/ and r["com.docker.compose.project"] =~ /^${stack:regex}$/) |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "container_name"])
